## Why visit

A useful specialist addition when you want Northern Monk’s cask as well as its more widely encountered modern keg beers. It offers a substantial range and a food option close to Port Street, making it practical on a Northern Quarter route. The reason to choose it over another modern bar is the documented four-line cask programme and real cider, not a claim to be a Manchester production brewery. It fits best as a flexible extra or food stop after the city’s more distinctive heritage and local-brewery anchors.

## Beer

Official page advertises four cask lines and twenty keg lines; CAMRA describes Northern Monk cask plus guests.

## Plan the visit

Cashless. Operator reports entrance steps and downstairs toilets without a lift or accessible toilet.

**Getting there:** Walk from Piccadilly or Piccadilly Gardens; close to Port Street Beer House.
